record_type_quote: The current study attempted to replicate and extend our previous findings that frPSI is a sensitive marker of early AD, and related to a unique pattern of volumetric loss in AD prone areas.

targets.authors: Loewenstein DA, Curiel RE, Wright C, Sun X, Alperin N, Crocco E, Czaja SJ, Raffo A, Penate A, Melo J, Capp K, Gamez M, Duara R
targets.title: Recovery from proactive semantic interference in mild cognitive impairment and normal aging: Relationship to atrophy in brain regions vulnerable to Alzheimer’s disease
targets.outcome_quote: Unique and strong associations between volumetric reductions and frPSI as observed by Loewenstein and colleagues were replicated.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The abstract gives an overall replication verdict; it takes precedence over region-specific differences discussed later.

reasoning: Independent sample retests the MRI-volume finding of reference 1. Amyloid and test-validation papers are background, not independently retested targets.
